studies.title: Model scene: Talk in a diner turns into a standoff
studies.plain: Long, funny talk over coffee, a famous song on the jukebox, then the music is cut dead and guns come out. The crime-film pattern of a long hold followed by a sudden spike.

beats.note: establishing the room
the camera circles the table while they argue about nothing
a gun on the table; the jukebox stops
a shouted line into the silence
a deadpan line breaks the tension
cheerful music over the violence

studies.title: Model scene: Two strangers meet over the same book
studies.plain: Opposites reach for the same book, trade quick lines, and the light warms as they warm to each other.

beats.note: two hands on one book
they start to like each other
one leaves without a name
a note left in the book

studies.title: Model scene: A dinner party goes wrong
studies.plain: A guest who can't read the room keeps talking; the camera refuses to cut away and the silences get longer.

beats.note: the first wrong remark
it gets worse
the guest finally hears themself

studies.title: Model scene: Someone walks down a dark hallway
studies.plain: Silence instead of music, one sound pushed forward, empty frame, then a burst.

beats.note: a drip, louder than it should be
the empty doorway
a false alarm
the burst

studies.title: Model scene: Practicing until they get good
studies.plain: One song carries many short shots of days passing, cuts on the beat, the light warming as the skill grows.

beats.note: early failures
a small fall played light
the first success, in slow motion

studies.title: Model scene: A boring office meeting, filmed like a documentary
studies.plain: Handheld camera, people glancing at the lens, a manager who thinks they are funny.

beats.note: the manager tells a joke
someone looks at the lens

studies.title: Model scene: A quiet goodbye at a doorway
studies.plain: No music at all, a held-back feeling, a long hold on a face, a hand that almost reaches.

beats.note: the feeling leaks out
a hand almost reaches
a small smile alone

studies.title: Model scene: One small mistake wrecks a kitchen
studies.plain: A dropped spoon starts a chain of bigger and bigger accidents, shown wide, with heightened sound and no real hurt.

beats.note: the spoon
a calm line amid the wreck

studies.title: Model scene: Someone starts laughing at a funeral
studies.plain: A quiet funeral, a small mishap, and one mourner cannot stop giggling. The laugh spreads, the room freezes, then the laughing turns into the crying they had been holding back.

beats.note: rows of mourners, an organ playing softly
the speaker's notes slip; the microphone squeals
one mourner bites their lip
the person beside them catches it
the whole room turns to look
they say the dead person would have loved this, and break down
a stranger in the next row holds them

values.roomStops.restart: someone breaks it with a line

beats.note: soft laughter and tears all through the room

values.roomStops.restart: someone breaks it with a line

studies.title: Model scene: A wedding toast that bombs
studies.plain: The best man thinks his speech is a sure thing. Every joke falls flat, he keeps digging, and then one honest sentence saves it.

beats.note: glasses tapped, the room goes quiet
the first joke
a few polite smiles
he explains the joke about the ex, then keeps going
the bride's grandmother frowns; he makes a joke about himself that also dies
he drops the cards and says why he loves his friend
the dead joke from earlier suddenly makes sense, and the room laughs
the groom shouts 'still not funny', and they hug

studies.title: Model scene: A betrayal found out in a parked car
studies.plain: A happy drive home, a phone lights up with a message not meant to be seen, and a long silence in a parked car says everything.

beats.note: singing along to the radio
a phone on the seat lights up
the passenger reads it; the cheerful song keeps going
the radio is switched off; the car stops; the indicator ticks
one quiet question
the driver tries to explain and makes it worse
seen from outside through the rain-streaked windshield
the door shuts; the driver is left alone with the ticking

studies.title: Model scene: A chase that bends the rules like a cartoon
studies.plain: A delivery rider chases a runaway dog through a busy market. Things that should hurt do not, the music plays every step, and the chase ends with both forgetting why they ran.

beats.note: the dog grabs the parcel and runs
through the fruit stalls
runs off a ledge, hangs in the air a beat, then drops
in one door, out another, past each other three times
a heroic slow-motion leap over a cart
lands in a pile of melons; the music stops
both stop, out of breath, and wander off together
the flattened parcel is still delivered, with a paw print on it

studies.title: Model scene: Seeing something enormous for the first time
studies.plain: A tired hiker climbs the last bit of a ridge. The camera holds back the view, then shows it all at once, and the music and the hiker both go quiet.

beats.note: heavy breathing, boots on loose rock
a muttered line about how this had better be worth it
the hiker stops; we see only their face
the canyon, all at once, the hiker a tiny dot at the edge
music drops away; only wind
they take out an old photo of someone who always wanted to come here
they hold the photo up to the view

studies.title: Model scene: Two sisters make up after years apart
studies.plain: Two sisters clear out their late mother's kitchen. Old jabs turn into a real fight, then a silly shared memory, then a forgiveness neither says out loud.

beats.note: boxes, dust, and too much space between them
sharp little jokes about who got the good room
who stayed, who left, who missed the last week
both stop; neither leaves
a tin of their mother's burnt biscuits, still in the cupboard
they both try one and remember how awful they were
the older one straightens her sister's collar, like their mother used to
she hands back a ring she took years ago; nobody says sorry, and nobody needs to

studies.title: Model scene: A school talent show goes wrong, then right
studies.plain: A nervous kid freezes on stage, the backing track fails, the crowd snickers. Then a friend in the audience starts clapping a beat and the whole room joins in.

beats.note: one spotlight, one small kid
hands shaking on the mic
the backing track starts
the track skips and dies
a nervous joke into the mic, then snickers from the back row
one friend in the third row starts clapping a beat
the whole hall claps along and the kid starts singing

values.yesAnd.end: topped by a big final line

beats.note: the last note, held

values.yesAnd.end: topped by a big final line
values.punchingBag.turn: a big win at the end

beats.note: the backing track suddenly comes back on, too late, and everyone laughs

values.yesAnd.end: topped by a big final line
values.punchingBag.turn: a big win at the end

studies.title: Model scene: A jealous friend at a party
studies.plain: At a friend's party celebrating good news, one guest smiles too hard. The jokes get sharper, the music gets louder, and the friend ends up alone on the balcony.

beats.note: a crowded flat; a toast to a friend's big new job
one friend's smile freezes for half a second
the jealous friend makes a 'joke' about the new job; the winner answers it straight
a joke goes too far; someone repeats one word of it back
the party roars on in slow motion around them
on the balcony, the party muffled behind the glass
the friend comes out with two drinks; a small joke at their own expense
they stand side by side, not quite fixed
